user.description: Choose a learning temperament. You can refine the operation mode and entity tracking afterwards under Configure.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Personality, operation mode, tracking and general options.

data.home_only_mode: Home-Only Mode (pause when nobody is home)

data_description.operation_mode: Shadow only observes; Confirm asks before every action (via an actionable notification); Active acts on its own.
data_description.track_mode: Standard learns from all entities (opt-out with the 'ignore_kontinuum' label); Labeled only learns from entities carrying the 'kontinuum' label; Automatic uses a smart heuristic filter.

evaluate.description: Run one engine tick; fires kontinuum_lite_anomaly if threshold crossed.

payload.description: Optional observation payload forwarded to the engine.

save_brain.name: Save brain
save_brain.description: Force an immediate snapshot of the learned brain to disk.

reset_brain.name: Reset brain
reset_brain.description: Erase all learning and reload cold. This cannot be undone.

set_mode.name: Set operation mode
set_mode.description: Switch between shadow, confirm and active.

confirm_action.name: Confirm action

confirm_id.description: The id of the pending action to confirm.

confirm_all.name: Confirm all
confirm_all.description: Confirm every pending action instead of a single one.

reject_action.name: Reject action
reject_action.description: Reject a pending action in confirm mode (negative feedback).

confirm_id.name: Confirm ID
confirm_id.description: The id of the pending action to reject.

no_entities.title: KONTINUUM Lite is not tracking any entities
no_entities.description: The engine currently tracks no entities, so it stays at cold start and never learns. This usually means Tracking Mode is set to 'Labeled' but no entity carries the 'kontinuum' label. Open Settings → Devices & services → KONTINUUM Lite → Configure → General settings and switch Tracking Mode to 'Standard', or add the 'kontinuum' label to the entities you want it to learn from.
